title: Changes location mid-conversation
persona: Sofia, 30, flexible on where she lives, indecisive.
situation: Gives one set of constraints, gets results, then changes a key one. Tests whether the agent updates state correctly instead of restarting or mixing old and new constraints.

turns.content: Looking for a whole 2-bedroom to rent, around $3,000, in Tampines.
Actually, on second thought, my job just moved to the west. Can we look at Jurong / Clementi instead?
Keep the same budget and size. And it needs to be available before October.
Great — of these new ones, which is closest to an MRT?
